items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All transactions are securely processed.
Standard shipping takes 5-8 business days within the US. Express shipping (2-3 business days) is available at checkout. International orders typically arrive within 10-14 business days.
We offer free returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with tags attached.
Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping rates and delivery times vary by destination and are calculated at checkout.

items.q: How do I find my correct size?
items.a: Refer to our Size Guide page for detailed measurements and fitting recommendations. Each product page also includes specific sizing notes.

items.q: Can I cancel or modify my order?
items.a: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 1 hour of placement. Please contact our support team immediately with your order number.
We're committed to sustainability. Our packaging is 100% recycled, and we're transitioning to more eco-friendly materials across our collections.
